notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Herd Baloth.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
